targets.queryText: SELECT pv.severity, pv.framework, pv.violation_type, ai.file_name, pv.age_days, pv.limit_days, pv.mandate, pv.detected_at FROM policy_violations pv JOIN asset_inventory ai ON ai.id = pv.asset_id WHERE pv.resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE pv.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT pv.severity, pv.framework, pv.violation_type, ai.file_name, pv.age_days, pv.limit_days, pv.mandate, pv.detected_at FROM policy_violations pv JOIN asset_inventory ai ON ai.id = pv.asset_id WHERE pv.resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE pv.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

targets.queryText: SELECT framework, severity, COUNT(*) AS total_violations, SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_violations, SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_violations FROM policy_violations GROUP BY framework, severity ORDER BY framework, CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
